policy: Scope and force identity review only, not independent certification of CDB numerical estimates. Exact complete date matching is necessary but not sufficient. Existing manually curated profiles remain authoritative. Original source NAM takes precedence over derived actors; combined forces use local military-unit IDs, never split totals. Optional participant IDs are restricted to existing source-compatible historical identities. Source-backed identityReview names may clarify local force labels, with historical evidence attached to the participant. Original NAM, numerical values, uncertainty and numerical provenance remain unchanged; reused participant IDs cannot be renamed. Explicit articleAliasReview may bind an original source title to a different published English title only with a dated, QID-bound, sourced review; this never relaxes date, force or quantity guards.
